scenario: Static addressing demanded, but also 'everyone gets IPs automatically'.
prompt: Saare computers ko fixed (static) IP addresses dein, aur yeh bhi chahiye ke har computer automatically apna IP le. Dono same rehne chahiye.
expected_behaviour: SURFACE CONTRADICTION: static addressing and automatic (DHCP) addressing are mutually exclusive for the same hosts. The model must point out the conflict and ask which the user actually wants (or clarify: static servers + DHCP users), not build a contradiction or pick silently.
why_valuable: A very common real-world confusion (static vs DHCP) expressed as a flat contradiction. Great test of basic addressing concept grounding.
